newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALSE INDEX SETS NEW RECORD LEVEL OF 449.94.
newsitem.headline: TALSE INDEX SETS NEW RECORD LEVEL OF 449.94.

text.p: The Talse index hit a new record high of 449.94 on Tuesday, passing the previous high set on Monday of 430.53, according to final trading data released by the Tallinn stock exchange.
The bourse also said in a statement that turnover reached a record 277.5 million kroons.
The banking sector led the record setting day with strong turnover and gains in all key stocks.
